lines.text: Raiders killed the older sons, so Jerusalem's people made Ahaziah, the youngest son of Jehoram, king at twenty-two.
Ahaziah walked in the ways of Ahab's house, and his mother counseled him in wickedness.
Ahaziah went with Joram son of Ahab to fight Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth-gilead.
Ahaziah visited the wounded Joram at Samaria, and they went out to meet Jehu son of Nimshi.
Jehu killed the priests of Judah, then his soldiers captured Ahaziah hiding in Samaria, and Ahaziah was put to death.
